Name: Golden Egg for Better Artisan Goods
Author: bunnyverse
Description:
[font=Arial]♡ hello! ♡

This is my first time publishing a mod. I hope you like it!

I used the chicken eggs from cometkins' original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url] mod as a base, and the color palette of the golden egg from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10852]Vanilla Tweaks[/url].

You can pick which size variant you'd like your golden eggs to be. You can also edit this in-game with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿~ [/font]
